sentences.text: Blue Bay Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-27 under the industry code 47712, retail sale of clothing without specialisation.
First sales are recorded on 2026-07-27, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-07-28.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a blue word but the registered industry is clothing retail.
